fields.description: What the applicant sees above the text, such as "How we use your information".
fields.label: Title

fields.description: The stable key acceptances point at. Rewording a declaration never orphans what people have already agreed to.
fields.label: Declaration Key

fields.description: Which registration this declaration is shown on. To show it on both, create it twice.
fields.label: Applies To

fields.description: The version currently published, mirrored from VMMS Declaration Version. Publish a new version to change it.
fields.label: Version

fields.description: Order on the form, lowest first. Declarations sharing a number fall back to the order they were created in.
fields.label: Sequence

fields.description: Required declarations must be accepted before the application can be submitted. Never applied to applications already sent.
fields.label: Required

fields.description: Unticked, the declaration stops being shown to new applicants. Acceptances already recorded are kept.
fields.label: Active

fields.description: Whether the published version holds its wording here or points at a page on the society's own website. Mirrored from VMMS Declaration Version.
fields.label: Source

fields.description: The wording currently published, mirrored from VMMS Declaration Version. Publish a new version to change it.
fields.label: Text

fields.description: The page applicants are asked to read, when the published version points at one. Mirrored from VMMS Declaration Version.
fields.label: Page Address
